open_items.detail: DONE 2026-11-25 (commit 3323d87d): takeover finalizes the in-progress recording segment (video.webm/trace.zip preserved in the session media dir) and resumes on release into a takeover-<n> segment subdir; browser/recording/start blocked during takeover; explicit stop during the pause reports the paused segment and cancels resume. PlaywrightDriver.stopRecording now truly stops video capture (relaunch without recordVideo — previously the context kept recording after a stop). Tests: 3 new M8-recording tests; browserd suite 77/77, typecheck clean.

Privacy M9 (DNS rebinding, policy.ts header + SECURITY_DISPOSITIONS.md SEC-11, Low): CLOSED by decision — documented as accepted residual risk; robust fix needs DNS pinning at socket-connect time. No code change unless newly scoped.

DONE 2026-11-25 (commit 195c0435): FakeModelAdapter takes a sandbox config stamped on ctx.sandbox; CLI --sandbox off|docker|bubblewrap (default off) + --sandbox-image; fail-fast with a clear error on a missing backend (never silently unsandboxed); trust rule documented in docs/EVAL.md + CLI --help. Also fixed 2 latent bwrap bugs in packages/tools/sandbox.ts (missing --unshare-user; --ro-bind / / breaking /work creation — now binds toolchain dirs read-only, /home+/root deliberately unbound). Verified LIVE on this VM (bwrap 0.9.0): full 31-task benchmark 31/31 under --sandbox bubblewrap; eval suite 52/52, tools 119/119, typechecks clean. Docker NOT installed here — docker-mode runs need a machine with Docker.
Known partial since 2.1.1: sign-out cannot unset the token in the running daemon (accountView delegates to auth extension sunday.google.signOut; no daemon-side token clear found in sundayd).
